text:
marco: Quick Q — NorthGrid (SI) asked what the minimal evidence bundle is for a GCP Marketplace listing. Do they need SOC2 + third-party pen, or can we accept a vendor questionnaire + signed attestation? :thinking:
ellie-partnerships: For full marketplace public listings we prefer SOC2 + independent pen, but for SI integrations sometimes questionnaire + attestation + compensating controls is acceptable. Which marketplace? govcloud vs public GCP?
sophia-security: short answer: public GCP can be shorter if they agree to timelines for an external pen test post-listing and provide the extra artifacts (network diagram, segmentation, and presigned evidence). govcloud and regulated listings still require SOC2 + 3p pen.
marco: This is public GCP. NorthGrid only has a completed vendor QA and an internal vuln scan. They want to jump on the listing timeline next week. Can we short-path with an attestation + internal scan?
sam-engineering: From an infra pov we can generate a deployment topology + terraform snippet and sample audit logs to show controls. That helps reduce risk. We'll need an owner to accept the residual.
ellie-partnerships: Action items: @sophia-security confirm acceptable artifact set & any conditional timelines, @marco ask NorthGrid to upload questionnaire + internal vuln scan by EOD Wed, and @sam-engineering prepare topology doc. Also decide presign TTL for artifacts. :white_check_mark:
sophia-security: Confirmed: for public GCP we can accept questionnaire + internal scan + signed attestation IF NorthGrid commits to an external pentest within 180 days after listing and to share remediation evidence. Required extras: network segmentation diagram, KMS/HSM manifest, and a list of third-party integrators. I'll route legal the attestation template.
devops-bot: Upload link created for artifact stash: https://rwd-infer-artifacts.s3/marketplace/northgrid/1772468100 (presign expires in 7 days) :link:
marco: Perfect — I'll send NorthGrid the checklist and presigned link, and will ping here once they upload. Thanks everyone.
